_comment: Copy to the config location shown by `classroom-parser --help` (or pass --config). Every key is optional.
_classes: Only read classes whose name contains one of these (case-insensitive). Leave empty to read every class.
_signin_markers: Text in the URL of your school's single-sign-on page, so an expired session is detected there too. Google's own sign-in is always detected.
_account_index: Which Google account in this profile (the N in classroom.google.com/u/N/).
